effect_mechanism: These are per-hectare costs of establishing mangroves, mostly by planting. Compiler-entered establishment costs are 427.38 USD/ha on a WOCAT sheet from Bangladesh and 150.00 USD/ha from the Philippines [ev_project_cost_wocat_4300_2019_establishment, ev_project_cost_wocat_578_2016_establishment]. Cited reforestation costs are US$946/ha in Thailand and US$211/ha for community-supported reforestation in the Philippines [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_3, ev_project_cost_hernmel17_4]; a community project in northern Viet Nam put the present-value cost to create one hectare of mangrove at 843 US dollars [ev_project_cost_ifrc11_1]. conditionality: The figures rest on different cost bases. The Mexican value, US$94.68/ha, was set by budget availability under a subsidy programme rather than being a full cost, and the authors argue it was insufficient for success [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_1]; several cited figures state no price year; and the meta-analysis range runs from direct propagule dibbing at the low end to very costly projects [ev_project_cost_su21_1]. WOCAT costs are compiler entries converted from local currency, and the World Bank figure is a value transfer from a cost function rather than an observed project cost [ev_project_cost_wbmang25_1].
